description: Use when the user asks which datasets they can read in the data library: their own uploads, datasets shared with them and datasets published publicly. Optional `query` filters by name or description. Returns each dataset's id, name, description, visibility, whether the user owns it and their access, its kind (spatial, table, samples, raster, document, text or image), the published layer (id, geometry type, feature count, fields), table (id, row count, columns), document (id, title, pages; text files are documents too), raster (id, size, bands) or image (id, size), its licence and projects, and the latest version's state.

project.description: A project id (see `projects` in each entry): only that project's datasets.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring of the name or description.

scope.description: all: everything you may read; mine: your own; shared: shared with you by others; public: published by anyone.

name: list_datasets
title: List data layers and datasets
